Subject: New vendor setup: payment terms + PO mapping for Redwood

Hi David,

Thanks for agreeing to register Redwood as a supplier in our AP system. We need to get a few items booked in order to process future invoices and create POs from our procurement system. Can you please provide the following so our onboarding team can complete the vendor record?

- Legal entity name used for invoicing
- VAT/Tax ID (or W-9 for US entities)
- Remit-to address and preferred remit currency (USD/EUR/GBP)
- Bank details: beneficiary name, bank name, IBAN/SWIFT or routing/account number
- Contact for invoice disputes (name/email/phone)
- Any EDI or API endpoints we should use for bulk invoice ingest (optional)

Attached is our AP onboarding packet with fields we require from suppliers. Also, please confirm whether Redwood invoices should include our PO number in the invoice reference (we map PO->invoiceReference/PO by default, but can accept a different element if your system expects it).

Quick timeline: once we have the requested docs and the portal record is created, we can issue the first PO within 2 business days.

Thanks,
Lina Torres
Vendor Onboarding Coordinator
CorpWave
